g.text: Median best-certified compression ratio with 95% material-bootstrap CI
A | Rate-fidelity ordering changes with the scientific contract
Protocol A.1 eligibility; denominator is the untouched 63-system cohort
B | The externally measurable cohort expands as tolerance relaxes
Pairwise win fraction among eligible material comparisons; bars show bootstrap interval for SZ3 wins
C | The SZ3-versus-ZFP crossover reproduces externally
External certification fraction among Protocol A.1-admitted systems
D | Certification remains high after conditioning on eligibility
A, pooled development and external rate-fidelity frontiers. B, external Protocol A.1 eligibility. C, pairwise SZ3-versus-ZFP crossover. D, certification conditional on eligibility.
The 63-system confirmatory cohort is distinct from the 65-system external descriptive/stability set; external rate-fidelity claims use only the frozen 63-system confirmatory outputs.
Eligibility expands with tolerance and the codec ordering changes with the scientific contract; no protocol or scoring rule was retuned for external evaluation.
